results.name: Tapping each physical ship module opens its purpose and actual operating metrics
Choosing a shield shows heat lost and radiation gained; cancel leaves equipment and stock intact
Confirming the selected shield changes real protections and safely stores the previous piece
Favorite protection blocks recycling and persists with a save smaller than 16 KiB
Recycling a unique specialist requires a warning and explicit confirmation; cancel is harmless
The laboratory opens as eight module categories with accurate visible resource stock
A recipe shows component counts, opens its ingredient and returns without losing the selected design
Handcrafted ingredients are consumed exactly by assembly and the module stays unequipped
A nested recipe can be assembled one ingredient at a time and returns to its parent module
Module and cargo cards open over the open ship and the Depósito card runs its services
Crafting only missing pieces keeps the parent ingredient and module recipe one step back
An active expedition prevents equipment replacement and both crafting steps without spending anything
A genuine previous save gains an empty component stock while preserving its ship and exploration
Module comparison and laboratory screens fit small phones without horizontal clipping
